integrity: Claim is supported by an explicit combinatorial proof and a standalone checker; direct exhaustive coefficient tests cover n=2 and m=1,2,3,4, plus n=3,m=2.
scientific_limitations: The exact polynomial is for finite cyclic maximal subgroups, n>=2, labeled unordered generating subsets; its subgroup-potential proof is general but explicit inclusion-exclusion can be exponential. Historical priority remains qualified by possible earlier equivalent gain-graph or Rees-semigroup counts. Independent external audit not performed.
title: Complete generating-subset spectra of cyclic Brandt semigroups
